2024_163_8_a_bp_3b_award_recomendation_v.paragraph: Barton Malow Builders submitted an award recommendation dated 9/24/2024 to Dan Trudel, Assistant Superintendent of Business Services, Troy School District, covering Bid Package 3B for the New Smith Middle School, with proposals received and read publicly on July 30, 2024 and August 8, 2024. Ten contracts are recommended across the remaining categories, among them Silverline Contracting for metal wall panels at $2,345,000 and Cortis Brothers Trucking & Excavating for earthwork at $2,949,700. Total contractor direct cost is stated as $9,403,112, with an 8% contingency of $752,249 and a total construction cost of $10,155,361. Barton Malow reports the projected cost of the building as fifty five and a half million dollars ($55,500,000).

**Correspondence**
Letter dated 9/24/2024 from Josh Eisenman, Project Manager, Barton Malow Builders (26500 American Dr., Southfield, MI 48034), to Dan Trudel, Assistant Superintendent of Business Services, Troy School District, 4420 Livernois Rd, Troy, MI 48098. Subject: BP#3B - New Smith Middle School. Contact given as (586) 651-2658 and Josh.Eisenman@BartonMalow.com. Proposals were reviewed with the Project Architect/Engineer, TMP Architecture Inc.

**Bid Opening**
Proposals were received and read publicly on July 30, 2024 and August 8, 2024. The attached bid tabulation carries issue dates of 7/30/2024, 8/8/2024 and 8/15/2024 and bid opening dates of 7/30/2024 and 8/8/2024.

**Recommended Awards**

| Category | Contractor | Base Bid | Recommended Contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3B.4 Metal Wall Panels | Silverline Contracting | $2,345,000 | $2,345,000 |
| 3B.10 Painting | R&G Painting Home Improvements LLC | $314,000 | $314,000 |
| 3B.11 Acoustical Wall Units | Clark Contracting Services | $374,800 | $374,800 |
| 3B.13 Casework | Division 6 Fabrication & Installation | $973,133 | $973,133 |
| 3B.14 Food Service Equipment | Stafford-Smith, Inc. | $751,821 | $751,821 |
| 3B.16 Gymnasium Equipment - Bleachers | C & M Associates, Inc. | $126,965 | $126,965 |
| 3B.16 Gymnasium | Interkal Inc. | $155,758 | $155,758 |
| 3B.23 Structured Cabling | Amcomm Telecommunications Inc. | $263,900 | $263,900 |
| 3B.24 Earthwork | Cortis Brothers Trucking & Excavating Inc. | $2,949,700 | $2,949,700 |
| 3B.25 Landscape | Heritage and Company, Inc. | $1,148,035 | $1,148,035 |

**Cost Summary**

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Total contractor direct cost | $9,403,112 |
| Contingency (8%) | $752,249 |
| Total construction cost | $10,155,361 |

**Bid Irregularities**
The low bidders in Structured Cabling and Acoustical Wall Units did not submit a complete bid and are not recommended. The second low acoustical wall units contractor, Clark Contracting Services, and the fourth low cabling contractor, Amcomm Telecommunications, were interviewed and confirmed that all identified work was included in their bids; both are recommended for award instead. In the signage category no bidder submitted a complete and/or qualified bid. The fourth low bidder, DMP Signs, submitted a complete bid but with an alternate product to the one specified; that product is being reviewed for equivalence, after which Barton Malow will either recommend award to DMP Signs or rebid the category. The expected cost of signage is carried in the projected total cost.

**Deferred Scope**
Work related to the traffic signal at the Livernois intersection remains in design and will be bid at a later date; the engineer's estimate for that work is included in the projected cost. Additional technology and security work will be bid separately and is allocated to a budget separate from the construction of the new building.

**Procurement and Program Cost**
The project was advertised on the state website for a total of five and a half weeks and drew 38 bids across these categories. The scope covers New Smith Middle School work not previously bid earlier in the year, and this recommendation covers the majority of remaining categories not interviewed or decided prior to the last award recommendation. Total construction cost including contingency on all previous award recommendations is fifty four million four hundred twenty four thousand nine hundred and sixty one dollars ($54,424,961). Including the estimated work remaining, the projected cost of the building is fifty five and a half million dollars ($55,500,000).
2024_163_8_a_bp_3b_award_recomendation_v.verbose:
Barton Malow Builders issued an award recommendation letter dated 9/24/2024 for Bid Package 3B (BP#3B) of the New Smith Middle School project in the Troy School District. The letter is addressed to Dan Trudel, Assistant Superintendent of Business Services, Troy School District, 4420 Livernois Rd, Troy, MI 48098, and is signed by Josh Eisenman, Project Manager, Barton Malow Builders, 26500 American Dr., Southfield, MI 48034, with contact information (586) 651-2658 and Josh.Eisenman@BartonMalow.com. Barton Malow reviewed the proposals with the Project Architect/Engineer, TMP Architecture Inc., and presents the recommended companies for consideration by the administration and the Board of Education. Bid proposals were received and read publicly on July 30, 2024 and August 8, 2024.

**Recommended awards.** 3B.4 Metal Wall Panels to Silverline Contracting, base bid $2,345,000, recommended contract amount $2,345,000. 3B.10 Painting to R&G Painting Home Improvements LLC, $314,000 base bid and $314,000 recommended. 3B.11 Acoustical Wall Units to Clark Contracting Services, $374,800 and $374,800. 3B.13 Casework to Division 6 Fabrication & Installation, $973,133 and $973,133. 3B.14 Food Service Equipment to Stafford-Smith, Inc., $751,821 and $751,821. 3B.16 Gymnasium Equipment - Bleachers to C & M Associates, Inc., $126,965 and $126,965. 3B.16 Gymnasium to Interkal Inc., $155,758 and $155,758. 3B.23 Structured Cabling to Amcomm Telecommunications Inc., $263,900 and $263,900. 3B.24 Earthwork to Cortis Brothers Trucking & Excavating Inc., $2,949,700 and $2,949,700. 3B.25 Landscape to Heritage and Company, Inc., $1,148,035 and $1,148,035. The summary lines read: total contractor direct cost $9,403,112; contingency (8%) $752,249; total construction cost $10,155,361.

**Award exceptions.** The low bidders in the Structured Cabling and Acoustical Wall Units categories did not submit a complete bid and therefore are not recommended. The second low acoustical wall units contractor, Clark Contracting Services, and the fourth low cabling contractor, Amcomm Telecommunications, were interviewed and have included all identified work in their bids; Barton Malow recommends them for award instead. All bidders in the signage category lacked complete and/or qualified bids. The fourth low bidder, DMP Signs, included a complete bid but with an alternate product to the specification; that product is under review to evaluate whether it is an equivalent substitution, and based on the evaluation Barton Malow will either recommend award to DMP Signs or rebid the category. The expected cost of the signage category is carried in the projected total cost. Work related to the traffic signal at the Livernois intersection is still in design and will be bid at a later date; the engineer's estimate for that work is included in the projected cost. Additional technology and security work will be bid separately at a later date, with that scope allocated to a budget separate from the construction of the new building.

**Procurement statistics and program totals.** The project was advertised on the state website for a total of five and a half weeks, and 38 bids were collected across these categories. The scope includes New Smith Middle School work not previously bid earlier in the year, and the recommendation covers the majority of remaining categories not interviewed or decided prior to the last award recommendation. Total construction cost including contingency on all previous award recommendations is fifty four million four hundred twenty four thousand nine hundred and sixty one dollars ($54,424,961). Including the estimated work remaining, the projected cost of the building is fifty five and a half million dollars ($55,500,000).

**Attached bid tabulation.** The attachment, titled TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT / Barton Malow Builders, BP#3B - New Smith Middle School, carries Issue Date 7/30/2024, Issue Date #2 8/8/2024, Issue Date #3 8/15/2024, and bid opening dates of 7/30/2024 and 8/8/2024.
